bahrain.title: NBB chief executive Usman Ahmed to step down at year end
bahrain.summary: National Bank of Bahrain is searching for a new group chief executive after Usman Ahmed decided to leave following four years in the role. He stays until 31 December 2026 to hand over, as the bank pursues its proposed merger with BBK.

bahrain.title: New worker-sharing rules let firms lend foreign staff for up to three months
bahrain.summary: MPs say the framework lets employers move workers between their own businesses, or to another employer for up to three months with LMRA approval and the consent of the worker and both employers. They expect lower recruitment costs, especially for small and medium firms.

bahrain.title: Apartment demand doubles as capital looks for ways to ease housing shortage
bahrain.summary: Demand for apartments among Bahraini families is up 105 per cent, according to a housing report discussed at a Capital Trustees Board majlis. Proposals include buying abandoned homes, acquiring unused properties and building upwards, with some families waiting almost two decades for a government home.

bahrain.title: Tamkeen to cover up to half the cost of software for small businesses
bahrain.summary: Tamkeen has relaunched its Digital Enablement and AI Programme for micro, small and medium enterprises. It will pay up to 50 per cent of eligible costs for software solutions and related services, with applications through its website.

bahrain.title: Outdoor smoking booths proposed for busy public places
bahrain.summary: The Southern Municipal Council unanimously approved a proposal to study enclosed glass smoking rooms for markets, parks and other crowded areas, modelled on those introduced in Taipei. The only such booths in Bahrain today are at the airport terminal.

bahrain.title: Four convicted of laundering BD 482,199 from drug sales
bahrain.summary: Four defendants were found to have moved drug trafficking proceeds through bank accounts inside and outside Bahrain to make the money look legitimate. The National Financial Intelligence Centre traced the transfers and the accounts were frozen.

bahrain.title: One dead and one injured after fall into elevator shaft in Al Fateh
bahrain.summary: Two people fell into an elevator shaft at a building in the Al Fateh area on Friday, the Interior Ministry confirmed. Civil Defence carried out the rescue operation at the scene.

bahrain.title: Number of hospitals and health centres up 32.6 per cent in a decade
bahrain.summary: Bahrain had 61 licensed hospitals and health units in 2025 against 46 in 2015, according to NHRA figures. Total beds stood at 3,338, of which 2,509 are in the government sector, and there are 425 licensed private pharmacies.

crypto.title: Bitcoin briefly tops $87,000 after weak US jobs report
crypto.summary: Bitcoin reached about $87,200 on Friday, just short of an eight-month high, after the US added only 29,000 jobs in September against 84,000 expected. The miss pushed bond yields lower and lifted stocks, though resistance stopped the price going further.

crypto.title: SEC proposes custody rules for crypto held by advisers and funds
crypto.summary: The US Securities and Exchange Commission proposed a rule on Thursday setting out which firms may hold the crypto assets of investment clients. It would also let advisers hold client assets themselves in limited circumstances.

crypto.title: Community banks sue US regulator over crypto trust bank charters
crypto.summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America filed a federal lawsuit against the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency on Friday. It argues the regulator exceeded its legal powers by granting national trust bank charters to crypto firms without the oversight applied to traditional banks.

crypto.title: Ethereum layer-2 network Blast to shut down
crypto.summary: Blast said the cost of running the network now exceeds its revenue and it sees no path to sustainability. Assets on the chain have fallen 98 per cent from $2.2 billion in June 2024, and its token dropped 19 per cent on the news.

crypto.title: NEAR Intents recovers all $3.8 million taken in exploit
crypto.summary: The full amount stolen in Thursday's breach was returned after NEAR Intents identified the person responsible and gave them 48 hours to send it back. The team says it is ending its investigation.

crypto.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs take in $2.7 billion in September
crypto.summary: The Block reports that spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds recorded $2.7 billion of net inflows during September.
